title: उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा पर्यावरणीय चेतना
nepali: प्रस्तुत अनुसन्धानात्मक लेखमा पर्यावरणीय चेतना भएका केही उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धलाई पाठका रूपमा लिई तिनमा प्रयुक्त पर्यावरणीय चेतनाका विभिन्न आयामहरूको विश्लेषण गरी उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा अभिव्यक्त पर्यावरणीय चेतनाको निरूपण गरिएको छ । यस लेखको उद्देश्य प्रकृति र मानव तथा जीवजगत् बिचको अन्तर्सम्बन्धलाई चित्रण गरिएका उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा अभिव्यक्त पर्यावरणीय चेतनाको स्वपरूप पहिल्याउनु हो । यस अध्ययनमा उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा मानव र प्रकृतिको आत्मीय सम्बन्ध, पर्यावरणीय गहनताको चित्रण, पर्यावरणीय नारीवादी चेतनाको प्रस्तुति, जनजाति र पर्यावरणका बीचको तादात्म्य तथा ग्राम्य र अप्रदूषित प्रकृतिको संवेदनशील चित्रण गरिएको भन्ने विचार पर्यावरणीय मान्यताका आधारमा अध्ययन गरिएको छ । यस अनुसन्धानमा सोद्देश्य नमुना छनोट पद्धतिबाट पाठगत तथ्याङ्क सङ्कलन गरी निबन्धको विश्लेषणका लागि पर्यावरणीय समालोचनाका आधारभूत मान्यतालाई सैद्धान्तिक पर्याधारका रूपमा अवलम्बन गरी निबन्धको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा गहन पर्यावरण, पर्यावरणीय नारीवाद, जनजातीय पर्यावरणका मान्यतालाई विश्लेषणको ढाँचाका रूपमा उपयोग गरी बाइस वटा उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्धमा वातावरणीय विनाशको चिन्ताका साथै सामाजिक पहिचान र लैङ्गिक सन्दर्भबाट आउने जनजातीय र नारीवादी पर्यावरणीय सौन्दर्य चेतनाका दृष्टिले पनि उत्तरवर्ती नेपाली निबन्ध सबल रहेको तथा पर्यावरणप्रतिको सचेतता सघन रूपमा रहेको छ भन्ने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ ।
american_english: This analytical article examines environmental consciousness in some contemporary Nepali essays by analyzing various dimensions of environmental consciousness used in them and describing the form of environmental consciousness expressed in contemporary Nepali essays. The purpose of this article is to identify the form of environmental consciousness expressed in contemporary Nepali essays that illustrate the relationship between nature and humans and living creatures. This study examines the idea that human and nature intimacy, environmental depth portrayal, environmental feminist consciousness presentation, identity with ethnic groups and environment, and sensitive portrayal of rural and unpolluted nature are studied based on environmental perspectives in contemporary Nepali essays. In this research, purposive sampling method was used to collect textual data and theoretical framework was adopted as a basis for environmental criticism to analyze the essay. Using in-depth environmental, environmental feminist, and ethnic environmental perspectives as a framework for analysis, it is concluded that twenty-two contemporary Nepali essays express concern about environmental destruction, as well as social identity and gender-based ethnic and feminist aesthetic consciousness.

australian_english: This analytical article investigates environmental consciousness across selected contemporary Nepali essays, dissecting various facets of eco-awareness found within. It aims to delineate the distinctive form of environmental consciousness articulated in these modern Nepali compositions, particularly those highlighting the intricate interconnections between nature, humanity, and the broader ecosystem. The study explores how themes of environmental intimacy, profound ecological representation, feminist environmental perspectives, ethnic and environmental identification, and the nuanced depiction of rural landscapes feature in contemporary Nepali environmental writing. Employing a purposive sampling technique, the research collects textual evidence and establishes a theoretical framework grounded in environmental criticism. Through a multi-layered analytical approach incorporating deep environmental, feminist, and ethnic environmental viewpoints, the analysis reveals that twenty-two contemporary Nepali essays collectively voice concerns about environmental degradation while simultaneously foregrounding social identity, gender dynamics, and multicultural aesthetic sensibilities.
informal_english: This article takes a look at how some modern Nepali essays are thinking about the environment. It breaks down the different ways environmental awareness shows up in these essays and explains what kind of environmental thinking is being expressed. The main goal is to figure out the unique environmental perspective that comes through in these contemporary Nepali writings, especially those that highlight how people connect with nature and other living things. The study dives into themes like close relationships with nature, deep environmental descriptions, feminist views on the environment, connections between ethnic groups and nature, and thoughtful portrayals of rural, untouched landscapes. Researchers used a specific method to gather text samples and created a theoretical approach based on environmental criticism. By analyzing these essays through multiple lenses - deep environmental, feminist, and ethnic environmental viewpoints - they found that twenty-two contemporary Nepali essays express worries about environmental damage while also bringing up important issues about social identity, gender, and multicultural beauty.
